desc: Compute nearest larger elements to the left ($L[i]$) and right ($R[i]$) for each element using a monotonic stack.

Implement the logic to calculate the maximum size for each starting position $K$. This involves determining the range $[l, r]$ that can be absorbed. The range is found by starting with $(L[K], R[K])$ and iteratively expanding left and right if the current sum exceeds the neighbor's value. To optimize, we can precompute prefix sums and use the fact that the "next" boundary to check is determined by the nearest larger element of the current boundary.
